many: 多少 (how many)；尽可能多的 (as many as)

talk: 谈话；闲聊 (have a talk / small talk)

要求；请求 (ask sb. to do / ask for)

call: 电话 (make / give sb. a call)

n.
说某种语言的人 (native speaker)
a person who speaks a language
n.
演讲者

small: little in size, number or amount

back: to the place where you were before
回溯；回顾 (look back / trace back)

leave: to go away from a place
使处于某状态 (leave sb. doing / adj.)

too: more than is good or possible

author: n.
作者
the person who wrote a book or text
even: used to say something is surprising

right: 立即；正好 (right now / right away)

show: to let someone see, or guide them

very: 正是那个；恰恰 (the very idea)
thing: an event or the general situation
